The Union Tube Transistor Beelzebuzz is a study in brutal simplicity. This one-knob wonder delivers evil distortion whose volume and gain increase together with a single control—no complicated settings, just pure aggression. The Beelzebuzz is designed for players who want in-your-face gain without the sustain that often accompanies high-gain pedals. It's raw, immediate, and unapologetically nasty. The lack of sustain gives it a punchy, percussive quality that cuts through any mix. Handcrafted in East Vancouver, BC with meticulous attention to detail, the Beelzebuzz exemplifies Union's philosophy of building durable, repairable effects for sonic connoisseurs who demand character over convention.
